patches.name: Enable Scan text
patches.description: Shows Gboard's Scan text tool (take a photo of words to type them). It is off by default and normally enabled remotely by Google, which the network guard prevents.

patches.name: Network guard
patches.description: Blocks all network requests from Gboard except for hosts in an allowlist. Adds a 'Network access' screen to Gboard settings to edit the allowlist and view a request log. Emoji Kitchen is allowed by default.

options.title: Default allowlist
options.description: Rules allowed out of the box (editable later inside Gboard settings). Each rule is a host ('example.com'), a wildcard host ('*.example.com'), or a host with a path prefix ('example.com/some/path/').

options.title: Block Play services hand-offs
options.description: Also refuse Gboard's connections to Google Play services (logging, config sync, ...), except for actions allowed in Gboard settings. Play services' own traffic is not affected.

options.title: Enable blocking by default
options.description: If disabled, the guard starts switched off until enabled in Gboard settings.
